# Empowering Human Potential

At Hanger Clinic, we care for our patients like family, working together to deliver the best
possible orthotic and prosthetic outcomes. With more than 900 locations across the country, we
create customized solutions for people of all ages, including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces,
cranial helmets, and other devices designed to increase the mobility and function of each person we
serve.
* **1 Million** Patients Treated Annually
* **925** Locations Nationwide
* **1,800** Clinical Providers
* **2,500** In-network Insurance Providers

*Numbers are approximate

## Patient Stories

[Shima Nixon][60] You have to get up, you have to keep moving. Everything that happened on my
journey was worth it because it pushed me out of my comfort zone. Now I get to be part of something
bigger than me. [Read Her Story ›][61]
[Shima Nixon][62]
[Alex Smith][63] Going back to how much I’ve benefited from the progression of medicine and this
rehab, certainly for limb injuries and leg injuries — I do feel like I owe on some level to push
this to see how far it can go for whoever may come after. [Read His Story ›][64]
[Alex Smith][65]
[Billy Parker][66] My best advice is what my mom always told me as a kid: where there's a will,
there's a way. If you want to get to the point where you're doing things on your own, you have to
keep doing things... Stay positive. Stay determined. [Read His Story ›][67]
[Billy Parker][68]
[More Stories][69]

### Hit the Trails This Summer: Your Prosthetic Hiking Guide

Hiking can be a great way for those with limb loss and limb difference to get active and see the
world. Preparation is key for a successful hike. Here are some tips, from checking your prosthetic
technology to having the right equipment and knowing your route.

[Learn More][70]

# Empowering Human Potential

At Hanger Clinic, we care for our patients like family, working together to deliver the best
possible orthotic and prosthetic outcomes. With more than 900 locations across the country, we
create customized solutions for people of all ages, including state-of-the-art prostheses, braces,
cranial helmets, and other devices designed to increase the mobility and function of each person we
serve.
* **1 Million** Patients Treated Annually
* **925** Locations Nationwide
* **1,800** Clinical Providers
* **2,500** In-network Insurance Providers

*Numbers are approximate

## Patient Stories

[Shima Nixon][60] You have to get up, you have to keep moving. Everything that happened on my
journey was worth it because it pushed me out of my comfort zone. Now I get to be part of something
bigger than me. [Read Her Story ›][61]
[Shima Nixon][62]
[Alex Smith][63] Going back to how much I’ve benefited from the progression of medicine and this
rehab, certainly for limb injuries and leg injuries — I do feel like I owe on some level to push
this to see how far it can go for whoever may come after. [Read His Story ›][64]
[Alex Smith][65]
[Billy Parker][66] My best advice is what my mom always told me as a kid: where there's a will,
there's a way. If you want to get to the point where you're doing things on your own, you have to
keep doing things... Stay positive. Stay determined. [Read His Story ›][67]
[Billy Parker][68]
[More Stories][69]

### Hit the Trails This Summer: Your Prosthetic Hiking Guide

Hiking can be a great way for those with limb loss and limb difference to get active and see the
world. Preparation is key for a successful hike. Here are some tips, from checking your prosthetic
technology to having the right equipment and knowing your route.

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

#### Who We Are

# About Austin Neuromuscular Center

Austin Neuromuscular Center was established in 2015 as a premier comprehensive Neuromuscular center.
Our team provides expertise in neuromuscular and electrodiagnostic medicine. Our center is equipped
with complete diagnostic tools needed to cover the breadth of neuromuscular diseases.

[Meet Our Providers ][28] [More About Our Practice ][29]

[Research Center][Research Center]

### Clinical Services

We provide a multi-disciplinary and comprehensive approach to the diagnosis and treatment of
neuromuscular diseases.

[Learn More ][30]

[Infusion Suite][Infusion Suite]

### Infusion Center

Our in-office infusion center allows us to closely monitor clinical outcomes, treatment adherence,
and the occurrence of adverse effects.

[Learn More ][31]

[Autonomic Testing][Autonomic Testing]

### Pathology Services

Our onsite neuromuscular pathology lab is both CAP and CLIA certified and offers advanced diagnostic
services.

[Learn More ][32]

[Pathology Lab][Pathology Lab]

### Research & Trials

National Neuromuscular Research Institute, PLLC is a center of excellence committed to research and
clinical advancement for neuromuscular diseases.

[Learn More ][33]

### What is a Neuromuscular disorder?

Neuromuscular disorders are diseases that affect the muscles and/or the nerves.  These diseases can
affect individuals of any age and are often progressive, in some cases even fatal.  Symptoms can be
muscle weakness, paralysis, respiratory distress, and intractable pain.  Quality of life for those
diagnosed as well as their loved ones may be altered dramatically.

[What We Treat ][34]

## Center of Excellence

Austin Neuromuscular Center’s ALS Clinic is honored to have been recognized as an ALS Association
Certified Treatment Center of Excellence. The multidisciplinary ALS Clinic went through a rigorous
process to achieve this status, and it signifies the clinic’s longevity, commitment to the highest
quality of care, and partnership with the national ALS Association.

#### Who We Are

# About Austin Neuromuscular Center

Austin Neuromuscular Center was established in 2015 as a premier comprehensive Neuromuscular center.
Our team provides expertise in neuromuscular and electrodiagnostic medicine. Our center is equipped
with complete diagnostic tools needed to cover the breadth of neuromuscular diseases.

[Meet Our Providers ][28] [More About Our Practice ][29]

[Research Center][Research Center]

### Clinical Services

We provide a multi-disciplinary and comprehensive approach to the diagnosis and treatment of
neuromuscular diseases.

[Learn More ][30]

[Infusion Suite][Infusion Suite]

### Infusion Center

Our in-office infusion center allows us to closely monitor clinical outcomes, treatment adherence,
and the occurrence of adverse effects.

[Learn More ][31]

[Autonomic Testing][Autonomic Testing]

### Pathology Services

Our onsite neuromuscular pathology lab is both CAP and CLIA certified and offers advanced diagnostic
services.

[Learn More ][32]

[Pathology Lab][Pathology Lab]

### Research & Trials

National Neuromuscular Research Institute, PLLC is a center of excellence committed to research and
clinical advancement for neuromuscular diseases.

[Learn More ][33]

### What is a Neuromuscular disorder?

Neuromuscular disorders are diseases that affect the muscles and/or the nerves.  These diseases can
affect individuals of any age and are often progressive, in some cases even fatal.  Symptoms can be
muscle weakness, paralysis, respiratory distress, and intractable pain.  Quality of life for those
diagnosed as well as their loved ones may be altered dramatically.

[What We Treat ][34]

## Center of Excellence

Austin Neuromuscular Center’s ALS Clinic is honored to have been recognized as an ALS Association
Certified Treatment Center of Excellence. The multidisciplinary ALS Clinic went through a rigorous
process to achieve this status, and it signifies the clinic’s longevity, commitment to the highest
quality of care, and partnership with the national ALS Association.

## A Message from Sharon Hesterlee, PhD, President and CEO

Whether this is your first visit or one of many, welcome.

If you are living with a neuromuscular disease or caring for someone who is, welcome.

If you are advancing care as a physician or clinician, or supporting this mission as a partner,
funder, or friend, welcome.

You belong here.

Since 1950, MDA has led the field in research, care, and advocacy for people living with
neuromuscular diseases. We’ve delivered *real* progress: research that supports more accurate
diagnoses, stronger care models, and therapies that were unthinkable a generation ago. We continue
to work together to elevate the voices of our community, driving regulatory and legislative policies
that recognize the agency and dignity of people living with neuromuscular disease. Lastly, we have
we created a community where people of all ages and any diagnosis can find connection, education,
and resources.

## A Message from Sharon Hesterlee, PhD, President and CEO

Whether this is your first visit or one of many, welcome.

If you are living with a neuromuscular disease or caring for someone who is, welcome.

If you are advancing care as a physician or clinician, or supporting this mission as a partner,
funder, or friend, welcome.

You belong here.

Since 1950, MDA has led the field in research, care, and advocacy for people living with
neuromuscular diseases. We’ve delivered *real* progress: research that supports more accurate
diagnoses, stronger care models, and therapies that were unthinkable a generation ago. We continue
to work together to elevate the voices of our community, driving regulatory and legislative policies
that recognize the agency and dignity of people living with neuromuscular disease. Lastly, we have
we created a community where people of all ages and any diagnosis can find connection, education,
and resources.

As a neuroscientist and as MDA’s President and CEO, I see the path ahead clearly: full of urgency,
grounded in evidence, and driven by people like you. Thank you for being here.

Let’s keep going – together.

# Her Why

[bestselling author cm harris]

C.M. Harris didn’t grow up dreaming of becoming an author—she became one out of necessity. Living
with a disability, she experienced what it felt like to be overlooked and underestimated. Instead of
letting that define her, she turned her challenges into purpose.

 

She wrote her first book, What If We Were All The Same!, to create the kind of story she wished she
had as a child—one that celebrates differences and shows that every child is worthy of love,
kindness, and belonging. Her mission is to write books that make a difference, stories that help
children feel seen, valued, and proud of who they are.


After nearly losing her life to covid in 2022, she is even more determined to reach her goals.

 

Through her work, C.M. Harris is not just telling stories—she’s creating a movement rooted in
empathy, inclusion, and hope.

## CMT affects 1 in 2,500 people in the United States and more than 3 million people worldwide.

 

### There is currently no cure for CMT.

[Donate Now][65]

##### WHO WE ARE

## Accelerating a cure through research funding.

**The CMT Research Foundation is a patient-led non-profit 100% focused on delivering treatments and
cures for Charcot-Marie-Tooth, which affects 3 million people worldwide.**

Since 2018, our donors and scientists have put CMT front and center in the pharmaceutical, biotech
and investor communities, making a cure for all types of CMT a not-too-distant reality.

### We have funded 6 therapeutics that are in preclinical or active trials

[See Full Research Pipeline][66]

##### Featured Content

## CMTRF Case Studies

## [Novartis' EKD060 compound for CMT1A is going to clinical trials][67]

Novartis acquired CMTRF funed partner DTx Pharma in 2023 for $1 billion. DTx Pharma created a
platform that delivers therapeutics to cells in a safe way. We introduced DTx Pharma to CMT and
funded their first CMT research with a grant of $128,000. The results from the testing were positive
and Novarts is now taking it to clincial trials.

[Learn More][68]

## [CMTRF underwrites Augustine Therapeutics’ HDAC6 inhibitor. Now, the Belgian Pharmaceutical
## company is in a Phase 1 clinical trial.][69]

CMTRF helped Augustine Therapeutics underwrite the development of novel potent and subtype-selective
small-molecule inhibitors of the cytosolic histone deacetylase 6 (HDAC6) enzyme to reverse and
inhibit the pathophysiological changes associated with neuromuscular diseases. Now Augustine
Therapeutics has completed their Series A financing round and raised $85 million, which will be used
to advance their lead candidate, AGT-100216, through a Phase I clinical trial. In May 2025,
Augustine announced the dosing of their first patient in a Phase 1 clinical trial.

[Learn More][70]

## [CMTRF underwrites Augustine Therapeutics’ HDAC6 inhibitor. Now, the Belgian Pharmaceutical
## company is in a Phase 1 clinical trial.][69]

CMTRF helped Augustine Therapeutics underwrite the development of novel potent and subtype-selective
small-molecule inhibitors of the cytosolic histone deacetylase 6 (HDAC6) enzyme to reverse and
inhibit the pathophysiological changes associated with neuromuscular diseases. Now Augustine
Therapeutics has completed their Series A financing round and raised $85 million, which will be used

## [Armatus Bio licenses ARM-101 from CMTRF funded-partners Dr. Kleopa (Cyprus Institute of
## Neurology and Genetics) and Dr. Harper (Nationwide Children’s Hospital in Ohio) for clinical
## trials.][71]

Drs. Kleopa and Harper developed a therapy that safely delivers miRNA, a PMP22 silencer, to the
peripheral nervous system. Upon successful completion of their CMTRF-funded project, Armatus Bio
licensed ARM-101 for further testing and now the therapeutic treatment is preparing for clinical
trials.

[Learn More][72]

### We have funded 6 therapeutics that are in preclinical or active trials

[See Full Research Pipeline][66]

##### Featured Content

## CMTRF Case Studies

## [Novartis' EKD060 compound for CMT1A is going to clinical trials][67]

Novartis acquired CMTRF funed partner DTx Pharma in 2023 for $1 billion. DTx Pharma created a
platform that delivers therapeutics to cells in a safe way. We introduced DTx Pharma to CMT and
funded their first CMT research with a grant of $128,000. The results from the testing were positive
and Novarts is now taking it to clincial trials.

[Learn More][68]

## [CMTRF underwrites Augustine Therapeutics’ HDAC6 inhibitor. Now, the Belgian Pharmaceutical
## company is in a Phase 1 clinical trial.][69]

CMTRF helped Augustine Therapeutics underwrite the development of novel potent and subtype-selective
small-molecule inhibitors of the cytosolic histone deacetylase 6 (HDAC6) enzyme to reverse and
inhibit the pathophysiological changes associated with neuromuscular diseases. Now Augustine
Therapeutics has completed their Series A financing round and raised $85 million, which will be used
to advance their lead candidate, AGT-100216, through a Phase I clinical trial. In May 2025,
Augustine announced the dosing of their first patient in a Phase 1 clinical trial.

[Learn More][70]

## [Armatus Bio licenses ARM-101 from CMTRF funded-partners Dr. Kleopa (Cyprus Institute of
## Neurology and Genetics) and Dr. Harper (Nationwide Children’s Hospital in Ohio) for clinical
## trials.][71]

Drs. Kleopa and Harper developed a therapy that safely delivers miRNA, a PMP22 silencer, to the
peripheral nervous system. Upon successful completion of their CMTRF-funded project, Armatus Bio
licensed ARM-101 for further testing and now the therapeutic treatment is preparing for clinical
trials.

[Learn More][72]

## Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease predominantly affects the nerves of the feet, legs, hands, and arms.

### This causes nerve damage, leading to muscle weakness and numbness.

Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease can take away the ability to walk, run, and move freely—but it doesn’t
have to. At Cure CMT, we provide direct funding for braces and surgery, giving people with CMT the
support they need to stay mobile, independent, and active. We’re here to make an immediate
difference—because when movement is possible, so is everything else.

We’re not waiting for a cure; we’re creating real solutions today so people can keep moving,
thriving, and living to the fullest.

> [
> View this post on Instagram
> ][19]
> 
> [A post shared by Glenn B. Pfeffer (@charcotmarietoothsurgery)][20]

[link_arrow][link_arrow]

### There is currently no cure for CMT

### CMT affects 1 in 2,500 people in the United States and 3 million people worldwide.

### CMT affects people of every race, gender, and ethnicity.

## We’re on a mission to make an immediate impact on the lives of people living with CMT.

### Braces: A Step In The Right Direction of Patient Mobility.

For many people with CMT, everyday movement can be a struggle due to muscle weakness, foot drop, and
balance issues. Braces provide essential support, helping to stabilize the ankles, improve gait,
improve balance, and reduce the risk of falls. The right braces can mean the difference between
constant fatigue and confident mobility—allowing individuals to walk farther, stand longer, and stay
active in their daily lives. By funding braces, we’re giving people with CMT the freedom to move
with greater ease and independence.

[ Need a Brace? ][21] [ Considering Surgery? ][22] [ Apply for Assistance For Surgery or Braces
][23]
[link_arrow][link_arrow]

### Surgery: “My New Feet Look and Feel Like a Miracle.”

For some people with CMT, braces alone aren’t enough. Severe foot deformities, muscle imbalances,
and joint instability can make walking painful and exhausting. Corrective surgery can realign the
feet, restore function, and dramatically improve mobility. While the decision to undergo surgery is
deeply personal, for many, it’s life-changing—reducing pain, increasing stability, and making every
step feel like a miracle. By funding these procedures, we’re helping individuals with CMT take back
their mobility and move through life with greater comfort and confidence.

We are looking to make an immediate difference NOW as we race for a cure for CMT. Braces and surgery
have an immediate impact, but we are actively pursuing a cure for CMT, strategically investing in
biotechs and companies that work toward this goal. We are making a difference for CMT patients now,
and for the future.

[ Surgery Options ][24]

### Providing Capital for a Cure 

##### **We are investing in the future of CMT treatment—boldly funding the breakthroughs that will
##### lead to the first-ever treatments and, ultimately, a cure.**

With more than 100 known gene mutations causing CMT, researchers now have the knowledge to develop
targeted therapies that can slow, stop, or even reverse the disease. Our mission is to accelerate
that progress by funding cutting-edge biopharma, biotech, and academic research with real potential
to change lives. We don’t just support research; we invest in it, ensuring the most promising CMT
projects get the capital they need to move from the lab to clinical trials and, eventually, to
patients.

Through strategic investments and partnerships with scientists, medical experts, industry leaders,
and the CMT community, we are driving innovation and pushing research forward at an unprecedented
pace. The time for waiting is over. CMT families need answers now, and we’re making sure they get
them.

Since 2008, Cure CMT’s founder, Pat Livney, has played a pivotal role in identifying and funding
groundbreaking research in CMT. His early efforts helped bring Sanofi-Genzyme into the fight against
CMT.

This is more than hope. This is action. This is Cure CMT.

##### Today, the number of companies working on CMT research has grown exponentially. Under Cure CMT
##### founder Pat Livney’s leadership, philanthropic investments in CMT research continue to grow.

## Our Impact

### Lily’s Story

“I have CMT, but it doesn’t have me,” is my motto. I was four years old when I was diagnosed with
Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease (CMT). Since then, it’s been a part of my life, but it has never defined
me. CMT affects my peripheral nerves, making movement and sensation more difficult, but that hasn’t
stopped me from pushing my limits and finding ways to thrive.

[ Learn More ][25]

### New Therapy

A new clinical trial is offering hope for people with Charcot-Marie-Tooth (CMT) disease. Researchers
tested a plasmid-based gene therapy designed to support nerve and muscle function. Unlike viral gene
therapies, this treatment can be given multiple times without triggering an immune response—making
it a promising option for chronic conditions like CMT.

[ Learn More ][26]

### Your Donation Can Change Lives

For people living with Charcot-Marie-Tooth (CMT) disease, something as simple as walking can be a
daily challenge. Braces and surgery can restore mobility and independence but they’re often out of
reach due to high costs. Your donations make these life-changing treatments possible.

## Caring and Commitment for a Healthier Community

At Doral Health & Wellness, we are proud of our commitment to our patients. We provide integrated,
interdisciplinary health services in our beautiful facilities, dedicated to the health and
well-being of our patients.

We partner with insurance companies, managed care organizations, and hospitals and others, as we
treat our patients with the highest level of care and respect.

Make an Appointment

### Patient Navigator

Our Patient Navigators at Doral Health & Wellness guide you through appointments, referrals, and

The onsite Doral Pharmacy offers fast, convenient access to prescriptions—providing medication
support right where your care takes place.

Doral Health & Wellness Care Managers work with you to manage chronic conditions, coordinate
services, and help you reach your personal health goals.

### Testimonials

## Inspiring Stories

Visiting the gynecology department at this clinic has been a positive experience from the start. The
gynecologists are incredibly knowledgeable and compassionate. They prioritize my comfort and health
in every interaction, making important aspects of womanhood so much easier to navigate.
Maria L.Gynecology Testimonial
Digestive issues were disrupting my life until I discovered the expertise of this clinic's
gastroenterology specialists. They conducted thorough assessments and provided tailored solutions
that brought me relief. Thanks to their care, I can now enjoy meals without the constant discomfort.
Alex B.Gastroenterology Testimonial
Managing my hormonal imbalances seemed like an uphill battle, but the endocrinology specialists at
this clinic were my guiding light. They truly listened to my struggles and crafted a comprehensive
treatment plan that suited my needs. With their support, I've achieved hormonal balance and regained
my energy and vitality.
David M. David M. Endocrinology Testimonial

  cancers, and about one third of them are malignant. Although some are primary, most arise from
  metastases to the brain. Learn more about risk factors, diagnosis, and treatment of these lesions.
  December 29, 2025
* [Preventive Cardiology in Low-Access Communities][65] Social determinants of health play a
  significant role in the development of risk factors for CVD and are increasingly a target of
  consideration for preventive cardiology interventions.
  Medscape Features Slideshows, November 26, 2025
* [Community-Acquired Infections][66] Community-acquired infections are contracted outside of
  healthcare settings, significantly impacting daily life. They range from mild illnesses to severe
  diseases such as pneumonia and meningitis.
  Medscape Features Slideshows, November 13, 2025
* [Can't-Miss Gastrointestinal Diagnoses][67] Determining the exact cause of gastrointestinal
  symptoms can be challenging. Delays in diagnosis and treatment may result in serious
  complications, including abdominal catastrophes.
  November 13, 2025
* [Gout for the Holidays][68] Gout is the most common form of inflammatory arthritis. Once called
  the "disease of kings," gout can result from holiday-related overindulgence in certain foods and
  beverages.
  November 13, 2025
* [In-Flight Emergencies: Practical Medicine and Ethical Considerations][69] As a medical
  professional, what will you do when the airline asks for help for another passenger having a
  medical emergency? Are you prepared?
  Medscape Features Slideshows, November 3, 2025
* [Alcohol and Wellness: What's at Stake][70] Alcohol use disorder (AUD) is a prevalent
  substance-abuse condition that affects every organ system.
  October 28, 2025
* [High-Risk ECGs][71] Rapid ECG interpretation is essential in the emergency medicine setting,
  often completed in under 30 seconds. Here, we review a series of ECGs with clinically relevant
  “can’t miss” diagnoses.
  Medscape Features Slideshows, October 21, 2025

## ERN EURO-NMD: "Breaking barriers and building bridges in rare Neuromuscular Diseases"

### [What is an European Reference Network?][153]

To review a patient’s diagnosis and treatment, ERN coordinators convene ‘virtual’ advisory boards of
medical specialists across different disciplines, using a dedicated IT platform and telemedicine
tools.

ERNs offer the potential to give patients and doctors across the EU access to the best expertise and
timely exchange of life-saving knowledge,...

[Read more][154]

### [About EURO-NMD][155]

EURO-NMD is a European Reference Network for the thematic grouping of rare neuromuscular diseases
(NMDs), a broad group of related disorders that represent a major cause of mortality and lifelong
disability in children and adults. NMDs are caused by acquired or genetic defects of motorneurons,
peripheral nerves, neuromuscular junctions or...

[Read more][156]

### [Relevant resources at a distance of a click][157]

Several essential resources support the EURO-NMD network, some supplied by the European Commission
and others developed in-house. The objective is to fulfil the ERN’s goals of providing streamlined
diagnostic and therapeutic features to support patient care across Europe and propel research in
neuromuscular disorders.

[Read more][158]

* [About the European Reference Networks (ERNs)!][170]

The European Reference Networks (ERNs) are cross-border networks that bring together European
hospital centres of expertise and reference to tackle rare, low prevalence and complex diseases and
conditions requiring highly specialised healthcare.

EURO-NMD is one of the 24 European Reference Networks (ERNs) approved by the ERN Board of Member
States. EURO-NMD has received funding from the European Union within the framework of the “EU4Health
programme 2021-2027”. [http://ec.europa.eu/health/ern][171]

## ERN EURO-NMD: "Breaking barriers and building bridges in rare Neuromuscular Diseases"

### [What is an European Reference Network?][153]

To review a patient’s diagnosis and treatment, ERN coordinators convene ‘virtual’ advisory boards of
medical specialists across different disciplines, using a dedicated IT platform and telemedicine
tools.

ERNs offer the potential to give patients and doctors across the EU access to the best expertise and
timely exchange of life-saving knowledge,...

[Read more][154]

### [About EURO-NMD][155]

EURO-NMD is a European Reference Network for the thematic grouping of rare neuromuscular diseases
(NMDs), a broad group of related disorders that represent a major cause of mortality and lifelong
disability in children and adults. NMDs are caused by acquired or genetic defects of motorneurons,
peripheral nerves, neuromuscular junctions or...

[Read more][156]

### [Relevant resources at a distance of a click][157]

Several essential resources support the EURO-NMD network, some supplied by the European Commission
and others developed in-house. The objective is to fulfil the ERN’s goals of providing streamlined
diagnostic and therapeutic features to support patient care across Europe and propel research in
neuromuscular disorders.

[Read more][158]

* [About the European Reference Networks (ERNs)!][170]

The European Reference Networks (ERNs) are cross-border networks that bring together European
hospital centres of expertise and reference to tackle rare, low prevalence and complex diseases and
conditions requiring highly specialised healthcare.

EURO-NMD is one of the 24 European Reference Networks (ERNs) approved by the ERN Board of Member
States. EURO-NMD has received funding from the European Union within the framework of the “EU4Health
programme 2021-2027”. [http://ec.europa.eu/health/ern][171]

## Chicago’s Local Medical Home Healthcare Agency for Seniors

At Essential Home Health Care, we are committed to being Chicagoland’s top choice for senior and
elder care. We understand the challenges that come with ensuring your loved ones receive the best
possible care, especially when they wish to maintain their independence at home. Our agency
specializes in providing compassionate, personalized services tailored to the unique needs of older
adults. Whether your loved one requires physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or
post-surgical care, our dedicated team is here to support them every step of the way.

We recognize that adult children often play a crucial role in coordinating care for their aging
parents. That’s why we work closely with families to create customized care plans that promote
health, safety, and peace of mind. With Essential Home Health Care, you can trust that your loved
ones are receiving expert care that respects their dignity and enhances their quality of life—all in
the comfort of their own home.

### Non- Medical Home Care & Home Health Aide Services

It is important to note that Essential is not a home care or home maker agency, but a medical
healthcare agency.  We provide nursing and therapy primarily through medicare insurance.

## Our Mission

To assist our clients in maintaining a safe and healthy home environment conductive to achieving the
highest level of functional independence in the comfort of their homes.

## Chicago’s Local Medical Home Healthcare Agency for Seniors

At Essential Home Health Care, we are committed to being Chicagoland’s top choice for senior and
elder care. We understand the challenges that come with ensuring your loved ones receive the best
possible care, especially when they wish to maintain their independence at home. Our agency
specializes in providing compassionate, personalized services tailored to the unique needs of older
adults. Whether your loved one requires physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, or
post-surgical care, our dedicated team is here to support them every step of the way.

We recognize that adult children often play a crucial role in coordinating care for their aging
parents. That’s why we work closely with families to create customized care plans that promote
health, safety, and peace of mind. With Essential Home Health Care, you can trust that your loved
ones are receiving expert care that respects their dignity and enhances their quality of life—all in
the comfort of their own home.

### Non- Medical Home Care & Home Health Aide Services

It is important to note that Essential is not a home care or home maker agency, but a medical
healthcare agency.  We provide nursing and therapy primarily through medicare insurance.

## Our Mission

To assist our clients in maintaining a safe and healthy home environment conductive to achieving the
highest level of functional independence in the comfort of their homes.

### Gillette Children’s Cerebral Palsy Institute

Gillette Children’s Cerebral Palsy Institute is the world's foremost innovator in clinical care,
forward-thinking research, and patient advocacy.

][148]
[
[Gillette Children's patient Joshua Reis and Dr. Tenner Guillaume talk during a visit.]

### Gillette Children’s Spine Institute

Gillette Children's is one of the nation’s largest and oldest providers of care for routine and rare
pediatric spine injuries and spine conditions.

][149]
[
[Gillette Children's patient, Katelyn Hall during an appointment.]

### Orthopedics

Gillette Children’s is home to one of the nation's highest concentrations of pediatric orthopedic
surgeons. This allows for a level of specialization not found at other facilities. 

][150]
[
[Physical therapist works with Gillette Children's patient]

### Pediatric Neurology

Pediatric neurology is a branch of medicine that studies and treats the nervous system, including
the brain, spinal cord and nerves in children.

][151]
[
[Gillette Children's Cleft Lip patient Micah Wagoner during a clinic visit.]

### Craniofacial and Plastic Surgery

At Gillette Children’s, you’ll have access to leading craniofacial surgeons and neurosurgeons who
specialize in caring for kids who have complex conditions.

][152]
[
[Mother looking down at baby in her lap - Gillette Children's.]

### What is a Rare Disease?

A rare disease is defined as a condition that affects less than 200,000 people in the United States.

## Welcome To The
## Hereditary Neuropathy Foundation

Our mission is to increase awareness and accurate diagnosis of Charcot-Marie-Tooth (CMT) and related
inherited neuropathies, support people living with CMT and their families with critical information
to improve quality of life, and fund research that will lead to treatments and cures.

## About HNF

Founded in the early 2000’s, HNF developed the Therapeutic Research in Accelerated Discovery
([TRIAD][37]) as a collaborative effort with academia, government, and industry to develop
treatments for CMT.

In accordance with the FDA’s patient-focused drug development guidance for enhancing the
incorporation of the patient’s voice in medical product development and regulatory decision making,
HNF has developed a regulatory strategy to [support FDA Guidelines ][38]to engage with industry
early on and assist with collecting and submitting robust and meaningful patient experience data,
and other relevant information from patients and caregivers, such as identifying what is important
to patients.

HNF is actively committed to increasing awareness and accurate diagnosis of CMT and providing
patients and families with critical information to improve quality of life.

## Welcome To The
## Hereditary Neuropathy Foundation

Our mission is to increase awareness and accurate diagnosis of Charcot-Marie-Tooth (CMT) and related
inherited neuropathies, support people living with CMT and their families with critical information
to improve quality of life, and fund research that will lead to treatments and cures.

## About HNF

Founded in the early 2000’s, HNF developed the Therapeutic Research in Accelerated Discovery
([TRIAD][37]) as a collaborative effort with academia, government, and industry to develop
treatments for CMT.

In accordance with the FDA’s patient-focused drug development guidance for enhancing the
incorporation of the patient’s voice in medical product development and regulatory decision making,
HNF has developed a regulatory strategy to [support FDA Guidelines ][38]to engage with industry
early on and assist with collecting and submitting robust and meaningful patient experience data,
and other relevant information from patients and caregivers, such as identifying what is important
to patients.

HNF is actively committed to increasing awareness and accurate diagnosis of CMT and providing
patients and families with critical information to improve quality of life.

# At the London Orthotic Consultancy, we offer evidence-based, custom orthotics with exceptional
# results and patient care

Our UK wide clinics offer some of the most advanced orthotic technologies available, from precision
digital scanning to data-led gait analysis.

Search the website
Search

## You can search for things like:
* a condition like ‘flat head syndrome’, ‘drop foot’, or ‘scoliosis’
* our locations
* guides for your condition

 

One of the UK’s few clinics to design, manufacture and fit custom orthotics in-house, as part of OP
Specialty Bracing
* ### Evidence-based treatment
  
  We provide state-of-the-art orthotic treatments that are backed by published and peer-reviewed
  evidence.
* ### In-house Manufacturing
  
  Manufacturing our orthotics in-house means we maintain full control over quality, precision, and
  turnaround times.
* ### Expert clinical care and knowledge
  
  We bring together clinical excellence and individualised care, delivered by our experienced,
  HCPC-registered clinicians.
* ### Leading specialist orthotic care
  
  One of the UK’s few clinics to design, manufacture and fit custom orthotics in-house, now
  strengthened by OP Specialty Bracing.

## Treatments and conditions

At LOC, we provide bespoke orthotic treatment for a wide range of adult and paediatric medical
conditions.

As one of the UK’s only clinics that designs and manufactures its orthotics in-house, we are
committed to supporting you or your child achieve your treatment goals.

[Book online][66]
* ### Cerebral palsy treatment
  
  Orthotics play a vital role in managing the symptoms of cerebral palsy, particularly as a child
  grows. Improving their mobility, gait pattern, stability and supporting their long-term
  musculoskeletal health.
  
  Every orthosis we create is bespoke, designed around your child’s goals, environment, and their
  evolving needs.
  
  [View more][67]
* ### Scoliosis bracing treatment
  
  The LOC Scoliosis Brace is a bespoke 3D scoliosis brace designed for three-dimensional in-brace
  correction. Each brace is tailored to your individual treatment goals to support non-surgical
  scoliosis management.
  
  [View more][68]
* ### Pectus carinatum bracing treatment
  
  Our treatment approach combines bespoke chest bracing and targeted exercises, which can improve
  chest shape appearance and symmetry without surgery.
  
  [View more][69]
* ### Pectus excavatum bracing treatment
  
  Our non-surgical approach combines a tailored exercise programme, vacuum bell therapy and a
  bespoke rib flaring brace to support people diagnosed with pectus excavatum.
  
  We’re proud to have provided pectus bracing in the UK since 2010, supporting patients of all ages
  with personalised treatment plans.
  
   
  
  [View more][70]
* ### Plagiocephaly treatment
  
  Our LOCband Lite is a lightweight, custom-made cranial remoulding helmet for babies with
  plagiocephaly. It is designed and made in the UK, with specialist orthotic support and a free
  photo review.
  
  [View more][71]
* ### Drop foot treatment
  
  Whatever the cause of your drop foot, we can design entirely custom insoles and orthotics to meet
  your unique needs.
  
  [View more][72]
* ### Club foot bracing treatment
  
  The Cunningham club foot brace is an effective and modern solution for treating babies with club
  foot.
  
  [View more][73]
* ### Spinal cord injury treatment
  
  Orthotic devices play a crucial role in the rehabilitation of spinal cord injury (SCI) patients by
  providing support, stability, and improved mobility.
  
  [View more][74]

### We treat many more conditions

[View all treatments][75]
Driving orthotic innovation to deliver smarter, more effective treatment for our patients
[Neuro swing Ankle foot orthosis made from carbon fibre]

## Bespoke orthotics designed with gait lab analysis

Achieve your mobility goals with pioneering lower-limb orthotics
* ### 100% tailored to your needs and lifestyle
  
  Every orthosis we create is designed specifically for you. From materials and lining to function
  and fit, we ensure that each device works seamlessly with your footwear and daily activities.
* ### Highly accurate gait analysis optimises function
  
  Using state-of-the-art gait analysis, we assess how you move to create orthotics that truly
  support your unique biomechanics. This allows us to fine-tune your device for maximum efficiency.
  Whether it’s improving balance, reducing strain, or enhancing performance.
* ### Designed using advanced 3D scanning
  
  Our advanced 3D scanning technology replaces traditional plaster casting, making the process
  faster, easier, more accurate and more comfortable for patients while ensuring highly precise
  measurements.
* ### Built with cutting-edge orthotic technology
  
  We incorporate the latest innovations in orthotic design, from dynamic support systems to advanced
  joint mechanisms that enhance mobility, improve alignment, and optimise rehabilitation outcomes.
  These technologies allow for better adaptability, supporting natural movement and long-term
  comfort.
* ### In-house manufacturing facilities
  
  We manufacture the majority of our orthotics in-house at our workshop in Kingston, ensuring
  exceptional quality control at every stage. This hands-on approach allows us to fine-tune each
  orthosis to the patient’s unique needs, make adjustments quickly, and maintain the highest
  standards of craftsmanship.
* ### Tailored footwear advice
  
  Orthotics can only work as well as the shoes they go into. That’s why footwear is never an
  afterthought in our process, it’s a key part of every assessment. We always look at your current
  footwear and provide tailored advice to ensure you’re getting the most out of your orthotics.

  Using state-of-the-art gait analysis, we assess how you move to create orthotics that truly
  support your unique biomechanics. This allows us to fine-tune your device for maximum efficiency.
  Whether it’s improving balance, reducing strain, or enhancing performance.
* ### Designed using advanced 3D scanning
  
  Our advanced 3D scanning technology replaces traditional plaster casting, making the process
  faster, easier, more accurate and more comfortable for patients while ensuring highly precise
  measurements.
* ### Built with cutting-edge orthotic technology
  
  We incorporate the latest innovations in orthotic design, from dynamic support systems to advanced
  joint mechanisms that enhance mobility, improve alignment, and optimise rehabilitation outcomes.
  These technologies allow for better adaptability, supporting natural movement and long-term
  comfort.
* ### In-house manufacturing facilities
  
  We manufacture the majority of our orthotics in-house at our workshop in Kingston, ensuring
  exceptional quality control at every stage. This hands-on approach allows us to fine-tune each
  orthosis to the patient’s unique needs, make adjustments quickly, and maintain the highest
  standards of craftsmanship.
* ### Tailored footwear advice
  
  Orthotics can only work as well as the shoes they go into. That’s why footwear is never an
  afterthought in our process, it’s a key part of every assessment. We always look at your current
  footwear and provide tailored advice to ensure you’re getting the most out of your orthotics.

  muscle diseases that become apparent within the first two years after birth. It is also the most

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

### The NMD Pharma story

NMD Pharma discovers and develops novel therapeutics for neuromuscular diseases.

NMD Pharma has a unique experimental platform focusing on ion channel function and electrophysiology
of skeletal muscle. We develop small molecule inhibitors of skeletal muscle-specific ClC-1 ion
channels that have a promising therapeutic potential in a range of neuromuscular diseases in which
muscle activation is failing leading to muscle weakness and excessive fatigue that compromise the
ability of patients to conduct essential human behaviour and cause lack of independence.

Our initial focus is on myasthenia gravis, spinal muscular atrophy, Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease, and
sarcopenia. Each of these diseases has a profound impact on patient's functional level and their
overall quality of life.

[
][81]

### About us

We are a team of more than 60 employees with expertise in all areas of drug development. We are
headquartered in Aarhus, Denmark, and collaborate with internationally renowned companies and key
opinion leaders in the field of neuromuscular diseases.

[Learn more][82]

[
][83]

### Pipeline

We are working to develop novel small molecule inhibitors of skeletal muscle-specific ClC-1 ion
channels that can be applied to a large range of clinical indications and orphan human diseases.

#### Investors

NMD Pharma has raised approximately $180M from leading life sciences investors to support the
development of a first-in-class platform of small molecule therapies that selectively target
skeletal muscle to address neuromuscular diseases.

[Learn more][84]

#### Careers

Interested in a career in neuromuscular disease research and drug development? Check out our
available roles.

[Learn more][85]

#### News

Keep up with our progress and follow our news.

[Learn more][86]

### *Enable better lives through novel therapies to restore skeletal muscle health*

**NMD Pharma wins EY Entrepreneur Of The Year 2022 in the Life Sciences category
**EY Entrepreneur Of The Year is the world's largest and most recognized growth creator competition.
It is a celebration of the entrepreneurs who build and run successful and dynamic companies. [More
Info][87]

Watch the EY Entrepreneur Of The Year 2022 finalist video [here][88]

**NMD Pharma wins the INCUBA award ‘Startup of the Year 2022’
**The INCUBA award is an initiative that pays tribute to the investors and startups who take the
lead and inspire others with their efforts in the startup ecosystem of Central Jutland. The award
highlights startups and investors who deliver significant results and contribute to pushing the
local ecosystem forward. It focuses on success, ambition, courage, innovation and those who go the
extra mile for their business or investments. [More info][89]

### The NMD Pharma story

NMD Pharma discovers and develops novel therapeutics for neuromuscular diseases.

NMD Pharma has a unique experimental platform focusing on ion channel function and electrophysiology
of skeletal muscle. We develop small molecule inhibitors of skeletal muscle-specific ClC-1 ion
channels that have a promising therapeutic potential in a range of neuromuscular diseases in which
muscle activation is failing leading to muscle weakness and excessive fatigue that compromise the
ability of patients to conduct essential human behaviour and cause lack of independence.

Our initial focus is on myasthenia gravis, spinal muscular atrophy, Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease, and
sarcopenia. Each of these diseases has a profound impact on patient's functional level and their
overall quality of life.

[
][81]

### About us

We are a team of more than 60 employees with expertise in all areas of drug development. We are
headquartered in Aarhus, Denmark, and collaborate with internationally renowned companies and key
opinion leaders in the field of neuromuscular diseases.

[Learn more][82]

[
][83]

### Pipeline

We are working to develop novel small molecule inhibitors of skeletal muscle-specific ClC-1 ion
channels that can be applied to a large range of clinical indications and orphan human diseases.

#### Investors

NMD Pharma has raised approximately $180M from leading life sciences investors to support the
development of a first-in-class platform of small molecule therapies that selectively target
skeletal muscle to address neuromuscular diseases.

[Learn more][84]

#### Careers

Interested in a career in neuromuscular disease research and drug development? Check out our
available roles.

[Learn more][85]

#### News

Keep up with our progress and follow our news.

[Learn more][86]

# NHS website for England Find information and services to help you manage your health

## [Health A to Z][8]

Find out about conditions, symptoms, medicines, tests and treatments, including when to get help

## [NHS services][9]

Find out about NHS services including GPs, pharmacies, prescriptions, hospitals and dentists

## Manage your health
* [ Order a repeat prescription ][10]
* [ View your test results ][11]
* [ Appointments and bookings at your GP surgery ][12]
* [ How to register with a GP surgery ][13]
* [ Find your NHS number ][14]

## NHS services
* [ Find a pharmacy ][15]
* [ Find a dentist ][16]
* [ Find a GP ][17]
* [ Find NHS talking therapies for anxiety and depression ][18]

[ Find other NHS services ][19]

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

## Featured
* ### [ Book a COVID-19 vaccination appointment ][22]
  
  If you're eligible for the spring COVID-19 vaccine, you can book a vaccination appointment now
* ### [ Get healthcare cover abroad with a UK GHIC or EHIC ][23]
  
  Get or renew your health insurance card to help you get healthcare in the EU and some other
  countries
* ### [ Refer yourself for help for back and joint problems ][24]
  
  Get NHS help from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services, like physiotherapy, for back and joint
  problems

## More information and advice
* ## [Vaccinations][25]
  
  Information about vaccinations for babies, children and adults, including why they're important
  and how to get them
* ## [COVID-19][26]
  
  Advice about COVID-19, including symptoms, treatments and how to avoid catching and spreading it.
* ## [Baby][27]
  
  A guide to everything you need to know about caring for a baby
* ## [Women's health][28]
  
  Information and support on health, wellbeing, conditions and screening
* ## [Contraception][29]
  
  Information about different types of contraception, including where to get them and how well they
  work

# Search 6,000+ free, evidence-based physiotherapy pages, created and reviewed by professionals

[Physiopedia Hero]
[

### Physiopedia Plus

Accredited online courses for continuing education and professional development. Earn certificates,
CEUs, and CPD points with peers around the globe.

][42]
[
[Physiopedia AI Assistant]

### Physiopedia
### AI Assistant

PAI your physiotherapy learning companion. Explore concepts, deepen your clinical understanding, and
build knowledge with AI-powered educational support

[Physiopedia AI Robot] ][43]

## About Physiopedia

Physiopedia is the world’s leading online knowledge platform for physiotherapy and rehabilitation
professionals. It brings together evidence-based clinical content, practical resources, and
continuing education to support learning, decision-making, and better patient outcomes. Built and
reviewed by qualified clinicians worldwide, Physiopedia helps students, educators, and practitioners
stay current, confident, and connected in an evolving profession.

0

[Learn more about Physiopedia][44]

## Contribute to Physiopedia

Join a global community shaping the future of rehabilitation education. Contribute your knowledge,
involve your students, or engage your organisation to help expand access to trusted, evidence-based
physiotherapy resources worldwide.

[
[Volunteers]

### Volunteers

Rehabilitation professionals worldwide can edit Physiopedia. Become an editor or join our volunteer
programme to share your expertise and support global access to rehabilitation knowledge.

][45]
[
[Universities]

### Universities

Universities providing rehabilitation education are invited to involve their students in
contributing content to Physiopedia as part of structured learning and educational projects.

][46]
[
[Organisations]

### Organisations

Clinics and professional organisations are invited to engage their staff and members in contributing
to Physiopedia through continuing education and professional development projects.

][47]

  Researchers in the 1950s began noticing a correlation between latitude and the incidence of MS.

  ][146]

  subsequently, overall survival.

  predictions for the future of research.

  ][150]

  members report poor mental health.

  It Takes Courage to Balance a Work Life and AATD

  By [Alyssa Gloor, AATD Contributor][160]
  July 24, 2026
* [[Man eating bowl of fruit]][161]
  [
  How Timing Snacks and Meals Helps Me Live With Pompe Disease
  ][162]
  Living with Pompe disease, I’ve learned that when I eat can determine how much energy I have to do
  everyday tasks.
  By [Bruce Campbell, Pompe Disease Contributor][163]
  July 24, 2026
* [[FSGS community group members talking and smiling]][164]
  [

  ][165]
  Beyond medication and treatment for FSGS, patient advocacy organizations can play a vital role in

  By [Jaime Albright Henighan, MSW, FSGS Contributor][166]
  July 23, 2026
* [[woman with nmosd in hospital bed and writing on her laptop]][167]
  [
  Is NMOSD Killing Me?
  ][168]
  A woman with neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD) reflects on the reality of her disease
  and the words we use to describe it.
  By [Jaimie Sheil, CIDP and NMOSD Contributor][169]
  July 21, 2026

## [Latest HCP Insights][170]

[More Insights][171]
* [ [Histology]
  What Causes Recurrent FSGS?
  ][172]
  By [Ariana Boswell][173]
  Recurrence of FSGS is a complex pathophysiological process influenced by immune function, genetic
  factors, and podocyte injury pathways.
* [ [Fetus in womb]
  How FcRn Blockade Could Advance the Treatment for HDFN
  ][174]
  By [Juliana Campos, PhD][175]
  Recent advances in FcRn blockade, particularly nipocalimab, offer a new way to reduce maternal
  pathogenic antibodies and prevent their placental transfer.
* [ [Pediatric provider interviews boy and family]
  Lessons From TK2d: Elements of a Successful Mitochondrial Disease Clinical Program
  ][176]
  By [Juliana Campos, PhD][177]
  Mechanism-driven design is among several traits successful PMD therapies share, as illustrated by
  doxecitine and doxribtimine for TK2d.
* [ [ANCA-Associated Vasculitis Diagnosis]
  How Sex Differences Drive RV Function and Patient Survival in PAH
  ][178]
  By [Jovana Nikolic, MD][179]
  The PAH sex paradox highlights how estrogen and myocardial architecture protect female right
  ventricular function and improve right heart failure survival.
* [ [female patient consulting doctor about treatment]
  Evolving Challenges in PBC Treatment
  ][180]
  By [Leonardo Jaimes, MD][181]
  Overall, PBC care is shifting toward personalized, targeted treatment rather than simply adding
  more drugs to the mix.

# Shape the Future of Rare Disease at NORD's Breakthrough Summit®

**Washington, D.C. | October 25-27, 2026**

Register now for the NORD® Rare Diseases & Orphan Products Breakthrough Summit® — the leading event
for rare disease advocates, industry leaders, researchers, and policymakers.

[Register Today][246]
[NORD Summit Hero Image]

#### [Understanding New Medicaid Requirements][247]

Starting in 2027, community engagement or work requirements will apply to some Medicaid enrollees.
NORD has explainers for patients and caregivers, plus recommendations for state and federal
policymakers.

[LEARN MORE][248]

#### [Your Experience Can Shape the Future][249]

The Living Rare Study® is the first large-scale, long-term U.S. study tracking the evolving
experiences of individuals and caregivers impacted by rare diseases. Sharing your story can help
shape NORD programming, inform policy decisions, and improve access to resources that enhance
quality of life.

[JOIN THE STUDY][250]

#### [Rare Science on Demand][251]

Missed NORD's Rare Disease Scientific Symposium? Explore expert presentations, breakthrough
insights, and key research and regulatory discussions shaping the future of rare disease.

[ACCESS NOW][252]
[

### Patient Assistance Programs

][253]

Get help with access to medication, diagnostics, caregivers support, and other needs through NORD's
RareCare® programs.

[Get support][254]
[

### Rare Disease Database

][255]

Access our comprehensive database to view reports on more than 1,400 rare diseases.

[Search now][256]
[

### Rare Disease Centers of Excellence

][257]

NORD® Rare Disease Centers of Excellence are diagnosing and treating thousands of rare disease
patients.

[Learn More][258]
[

### IAMRARE^{®} Program

][259]

Assist researchers throughout the world better understand and treat rare diseases by enrolling in
our registry and sharing your experiences.

[Get involved][260]
[

### Living Rare Study®

][261]

Adults living with rare disease and caregivers can share their lived experiences to help drive
positive change.

[Participate Today][262]
[

### Help Advance Research

][263]

Discover how your rare experiences can help researchers and lead to a brighter future.

[Learn More][264]

## Shark Tooth Biotech

## Developing treatments for CMT1A
## and unlocking solutions for other neuropathies 

[Support Our Mission ][5]

## Our Mission

Founded by a father whose son lives with Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 1A (CMT1A), Shark Tooth is
a mission-driven company dedicated to developing treatments for the 1.6 million people worldwide
living with CMT1A.

### Why now?

The first proof that CMT1A could be treated came in 2017, when an RNA therapy reversed the disease
in mice, though the required dose was unsafe for humans.

 

Since then, RNA science has advanced rapidly, accelerated by the global push during COVID, creating
new chemistries and delivery technologies that were unavailable 8 years ago and remain untested for
CMT1A.

 

At the same time, new AI tools now enable much faster development of therapeutic approaches.

 

Together, these advances make the path to an effective CMT1A treatment more achievable than ever.

### What's the impact?

While CMT1A is rare, it's the most common rare disease without any treatment or cure affecting 1.6M
people worldwide.
 
Thanks to government incentives such as the “Orphan Disease Designation”, the TAM for CMT1A is
approximately $14B per year in the US alone.
 
Furthermore, solving CMT1A paves the way for treatments for other peripheral nerve diseases
impacting 5M people worldwide.

### What's our approach?

We will not reinvent the wheel.

 

We focus on using what already works. Our goal is not to create new drugs from scratch, but to
assemble the right pieces by partnering with leading labs and funding the research needed to test
whether their proprietary technologies can be applied to CMT1A.

 

Rather than making CMT1A the first condition treated with a new platform, we aim for it to be the
10th, building on technologies that have already proven themselves in other diseases.

### How can you help?

At this pivotal stage, we need your support to transform our vision into reality.


We gratefully welcome both investments and tax-deductible donations to advance our mission.


If you’d like to explore ways to contribute or learn more about supporting our efforts, please reach
out: [apple@sharktooth.bio][6].

 

Together, we can make a difference.

## Focus on "Drug Assembly" 
## rather than "New Drug Discovery"

With support from our scientific advisors from Harvard, Johns Hopkins, and leading biotech
executives, we've developed a hypothesis on how to accelerate the path to a treatment for CMT1A. 

 

We are convinced that the technology that will lead to the first treatment for CMT1A already exists
-- it just hasn't been applied to CMT1A yet.


As such, our focus is not on new drug discovery, but rather on what we are calling "Drug Assembly":
partnering with labs to fund the research to test if their technology could lead to the first
treatment for CMT1A.

# Celebrating 170 years

A legacy of healthcare innovation. A future without limits.

Discover our story

# Life Unlimited

Smith+Nephew is a portfolio medical technology company focused on the repair, regeneration and
replacement of soft and hard tissue. We exist to restore people's bodies and their self-belief by
using technology to take the limits off living.

[Sports Medicine]

# Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

Explore sports medicine
[Ultimate victory]

# Ultimate victory

Hear the story of how our technology, in the hands of a leading surgeon, helped Tom Aspinall recover
from a career-threatening injury to become the UFC world heavyweight champion.

Explore Tom Aspinall's story

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## Our academic difference sets us apart

As a university-based medical center, we’re more than a community hospital. Research and education
are part of our mission, which informs the care we provide to you.
[A patient receives care during a clinical trial at UI Health Care.]
Research and innovation

Clinical trials give you access to new and promising drugs, procedures, and medical devices—and
helps us better understand and treat injuries and disease.

[Browse all clinical trials][128]

[Family Medicine residents Ofure Omokhodion, MBChB, and Sarah Costello, MD, with medical director
Jessica Rockafellow, MD, in the Family Medicine inpatient unit 3 Center at UI Health Care Medical
Center Downtown on Wednesday, July 9, 2025. ]
Education and training

As a teaching hospital, we’re preparing the next generation of health care providers. We’re always
learning, too, which leads to better care and better outcomes for you.

[Learn about the Carver College of Medicine][129]

[Urologist Helen Hougen, MD, with simulated patient at the urology clinic at UI Health Care Iowa
River Landing on Tuesday, Nov. 12, 2024.]
Rankings and distinctions

We’re Iowa’s No. 1 hospital, with national rankings and distinctions in many medical specialties.
We’re also the first in Iowa to be designated a Magnet hospital for excellence in nursing.

[More about UI Health Care][130]

### World-class care, convenient locations

Find the right care at the right place to fit your medical needs—from our main hospital campus in
Iowa City, or one of dozens of offsite locations throughout Iowa.

## Our academic difference sets us apart

As a university-based medical center, we’re more than a community hospital. Research and education
are part of our mission, which informs the care we provide to you.
[A patient receives care during a clinical trial at UI Health Care.]
Research and innovation

Clinical trials give you access to new and promising drugs, procedures, and medical devices—and
helps us better understand and treat injuries and disease.

[Browse all clinical trials][128]

[Family Medicine residents Ofure Omokhodion, MBChB, and Sarah Costello, MD, with medical director
Jessica Rockafellow, MD, in the Family Medicine inpatient unit 3 Center at UI Health Care Medical
Center Downtown on Wednesday, July 9, 2025. ]
Education and training

As a teaching hospital, we’re preparing the next generation of health care providers. We’re always
learning, too, which leads to better care and better outcomes for you.

[Learn about the Carver College of Medicine][129]

[Urologist Helen Hougen, MD, with simulated patient at the urology clinic at UI Health Care Iowa
River Landing on Tuesday, Nov. 12, 2024.]
Rankings and distinctions

We’re Iowa’s No. 1 hospital, with national rankings and distinctions in many medical specialties.
We’re also the first in Iowa to be designated a Magnet hospital for excellence in nursing.

[More about UI Health Care][130]

Find the right care at the right place to fit your medical needs—from our main hospital campus in
Iowa City, or one of dozens of offsite locations throughout Iowa.
